newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woodside says awaits Cossack restart.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woodside says awaits Cossack restart.

text.p: The Cossack Pioneer offshore oil platform in Western Australia remained shut in over the weekend but is expected to resume production later on Monday, a spokesman for the operator, Woodside Petroleum Ltd said.
"It's sitting next to the riser awaiting the right condtions," the spokesman said.

The Cossack Pioneer was producing at a rate of about 65,000 barrels a day before disconnecting from its mooring last Thursday as a tropical low off the Western Australia coast threatened to build into a cyclone.
The low never reached cyclone status and over the weekend showed signs of weakening, the Bureau of Meteorology said.
At its peak, the low produced swells of between one and two metres in height, the bureau said.

Equal-stake partners in the North West Shelf, where the Cossack Pioneer field is situated, are units of The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, The British Petroleum Co Plc, Japan Australia LNG (MiMi) Pty Ltd -- a partnership of Mitsui & Co Ltd and Mitsubishi Corp -- Chevron Corp, the Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Woodside.
